subject.title: fix(signal): detect native bot mentions in group gating

question: Should OpenClaw accept stricter Signal native-only `requireMention` behavior for existing groups with configured bot identity but no text mention patterns?
rationale: The code path is localized and tested, but the upgrade behavior is intentionally user-visible and compatibility-sensitive, so automation should not make the policy call.

options.title: Accept Stricter Native Gating
options.body: Merge with the documented behavior that native-only Signal `requireMention` groups now drop unmentioned group messages into bounded pending context when bot identity is configured.

options.title: Require Transition Policy
options.body: Ask for an explicit migration, opt-in mode, or release-note policy if preserving old pass-through behavior matters for existing deployments.

options.title: Pause Native Identity Enforcement
options.body: Do not land this runtime behavior change until maintainers decide whether configured Signal identity should make mention detection enforceable.

recommendation.title: Accept Stricter Native Gating
recommendation.body: Merge with the documented behavior that native-only Signal `requireMention` groups now drop unmentioned group messages into bounded pending context when bot identity is configured.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared mention-policy and Signal test history makes this the best available routing owner for the compatibility decision.
